title: The Killer Angels
author: Michael Shaara
summary: The novel covers the four days of the Battle of Gettysburg in 1863, told from the viewpoints of commanders on both sides, including Lee, Longstreet and the Union colonel Joshua Chamberlain.
readIf: you like military history written as character-focused fiction.
skipIf: you want romance or a small-scale story away from the battlefield.
